scope.question: Can Dream7B diffusion be accurately deployed on S100P?
scope.accuracy_definition: layered evidence: compile, S100P runtime, numerical logits, generation quality, product route.

logits_numerically_valid.required_evidence: CPU/BF16 or GGUF reference vs BPU dequantized logits/top-k/cosine/entropy report.

generation_quality_valid.required_evidence: pre-registered prompt battery output with no garbled/token-leak/empty replies.

product_route_valid.required_evidence: 18889 isolation, foreground fallback to 18888, rollback, health, queue drain, latency and failure-rate logs.

notes: leap_llm FakeQuantLinear was hotfixed on cloud to support w_bits=16 in build() for final lm_head.
compile_dream_true_batch_segments.sh was patched so BATCH_SIZE=1 filenames omit _b1 and link HBM correctly.
Only HBM files are required for the deployment package; BC/HBO intermediates remain on cloud output_root.

negative_controls.claim: seq16 BPU single-request chat is structurally blocked by fixed 16-token window, 12-token prompt tail, and 4 mask slots.
seq16 BPU logits produced garbage text versus GGUF/CPU on the same 16-token input.
negative_controls.required_text: BPU diffusion generation produces garbage text

negative_controls.claim: late-layer hidden states saturated int16 in seg21_24 and seg24_26.
negative_controls.required_text: int16 saturation in seg21_24 and seg24_26

negative_controls.claim: q8 lm_head without calibration compressed logits; seq128 package therefore uses lm_head q16 last-token head.
negative_controls.required_text: q8 weight quantization of lm_head without calibration

negative_controls.claim: 18888 remains protected foreground GGUF route; BPU/true-batch remains isolated until all quality and product gates pass.
negative_controls.required_text: Do not route foreground OpenClaw replies to BPU/true-batch
